learned.title: Tag the act too and the post is twice as likely to be shared
learned.note: This week's seventeen single posts, by who was tagged in the picture. A share is the venue or the act putting the post in its own story, and a shared post has averaged 148 people over three weeks against 22 for the rest.

moves.title: Half the posts go out a day early
moves.why: You asked for it Friday: every post went out hours before doors, so the venue had no time to reshare. Half go a day early from Wednesday.
moves.plan: From Wed Oct 28 half of each week's dated posts go out 24 hours before their old slot, the other half at the old time, swapping each week, so the venue and the act have a day to reshare. The review reads the two sides every Monday and picks the winner by Nov 23. Say don't and every post stays day-of.

moves.title: The Reel opens on the feature, not the title card
moves.why: Two Reels, 116 and 46 seconds, both lost people at eleven seconds. The title card is what they skip. The feature's quip opens instead.
moves.plan: From Wed Oct 28 the Reel starts on the feature's picture and quip; the title card plays second and says where the rest are. If this third Reel still reads under the week's ordinary post, the Reel is dropped on Nov 2. Say don't and the title card stays first.

done.title: Every story named its act, or said why not.
done.text: Seven posts tagged the act in the picture, three were shared. Ten tagged the venue alone, two were shared. The gate stays.

done.title: The 46-second Reel read 16.
done.text: People watched 11 seconds again, but 24% of it instead of 10%, and 44% skipped instead of 68%. The opening is the next fix.

done.title: The first save, ever.
done.text: Somebody saved the weekend roundup. 168 posts, one save. Shares went 16 to 21; 85 accounts were followed this week, the most ever.
